categories.main_business_segments: Nanya New Material Technology Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the design, research, production, and sales of copper clad laminates (CCL) and prepregs, which are composite materials used in printed circuit boards (PCBs). Their product portfolio includes various types of laminates such as standard FR-4, lead-free compatible, halogen-free, high-frequency, automotive, energy, HDI, and IC substrate materials. The company also produces prepregs, which are essential intermediate products in laminate manufacturing. These products serve multiple end markets including consumer electronics, communications, data centers, automotive electronics, aerospace, and industrial control.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies revolve around advanced formulation techniques for laminates, including lead-free, halogen-free, high-frequency, high-speed, automotive-grade, high thermal conductivity, HDI, low coefficient of thermal expansion (CTE), and IC substrate materials. Production methods include proprietary filler dispersion, resin impregnation, ultra-thin prepreg manufacturing, voltage resistance control, dimensional stability control, and thickness uniformity enhancement for high-frequency products. The company maintains a comprehensive quality control system and has developed a smart manufacturing platform integrating PLM, APS, MES, QMS, WMS, and SCADA systems for full lifecycle product management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major PCB manufacturers such as Kinwong, Unimicron, Tripod, Shenghong, and others, as well as leading end customers like Huawei, ZTE, Inspur, Samsung, and H3C. The company serves diverse markets including telecommunications (5G base stations, AI servers, data centers), consumer electronics (smartphones, laptops, wearable devices), automotive electronics (traditional and new energy vehicles), LED displays, and industrial applications. The company focuses on high-end and mid-to-high-end market segments, with increasing penetration in overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai, Jiangxi, Guangdong, and Jiangsu provinces, and has established overseas subsidiaries and production facilities in Singapore, Hong Kong, and Thailand. Domestic sales account for over 94% of revenue, with international sales making up about 6%. The company is actively expanding its global footprint by setting up representative offices and recruiting local talent in key overseas markets to enhance competitiveness.
categories.supply_chain_position: Nanya New Material operates upstream and midstream in the electronics materials supply chain, focusing on the production of core PCB materials such as copper clad laminates and prepregs. It sources raw materials like electronic copper foil, glass fiber cloth, and resin from upstream suppliers and supplies its products directly to PCB manufacturers and OEM/ODM customers downstream. The company also emphasizes domestic supply chain localization to reduce reliance on imports and enhance supply security.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes continuous innovation in high-speed, high-frequency, automotive, HDI, IC substrate, high thermal conductivity, and halogen-free materials. It invests significantly in R&D, with over 5% of revenue allocated to research activities, focusing on developing new formulations and production technologies to meet evolving market demands. The company also emphasizes digital transformation and smart manufacturing to improve operational efficiency and product quality. Strategic R&D projects target 5G communications, AI computing, automotive electronics, and advanced packaging materials.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of copper clad laminates and prepregs to PCB manufacturers and OEM/ODM customers. The company mainly uses a direct sales model, supplemented by limited distribution channels. Revenue recognition occurs at the point of delivery and customer acceptance for domestic sales, and upon customs clearance and receipt of payment for exports. The company also receives government subsidies related to R&D and production.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Nanya New Material is one of the leading domestic players in the copper clad laminate industry in China, ranked among the top ten globally with a market share of approximately 3.2%. It competes with both domestic and international suppliers, including foreign companies that dominate the high-end product segment. The company differentiates itself through strong R&D capabilities, comprehensive product lines, quality certifications, and close cooperation with major PCB and end customers. It has achieved import substitution in several high-end product categories.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.36 billion, representing a 12.7% increase year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders turned positive at RMB 50.32 million, recovering from a loss in the previous year. Total assets reached RMB 4.57 billion, up 1.71%, while net assets slightly decreased by 0.74% to RMB 2.43 billion. The company maintains a stable growth trajectory supported by increased sales, improved operational efficiency, and enhanced product mix favoring high-margin products.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Nanya New Material emphasizes its comprehensive and mature product portfolio that covers a wide range of application needs from standard to high-end laminates, including specialized materials for 5G, AI, automotive, and IC packaging. Its core competitive advantages lie in proprietary formulation technologies, advanced manufacturing processes, stringent quality control, and strong customer service. The company’s ability to provide customized solutions, achieve import substitution, and maintain certifications from major international and domestic bodies enhances its value proposition as a reliable and innovative supplier in the electronics materials industry.
